scope: Proposition 7.2 of the manuscript “Sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring constants” (preprints/Sharp-One-Dimensional-Lieb-Thirring-Constants-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 262 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 58446aaaaebf0ed0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let I be a bounded interval and 0 ≤ W ∈ Lp(I). If −k2 1, . . . , −k2 N are the first N negative Dirichlet eigenvalues of −d2/dx2 − W, ordered so that k1 ≥ · · · ≥ kN > 0, then N X j=1 k2γ j ≤ ℓσ Z I Wp . (7.3)
